description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various pre-trained models on the multi-document summarization (MDS) task, measured by the ROUGE-G score, which is the geometric mean of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores. The x-axis represents the number of training examples, ranging from 0 to 64, while the y-axis shows the ROUGE-G score, ranging from approximately 11.0 to 19.0. The plot includes four lines representing different models: PELMS (solid green line), PELMS (5%) (solid red line), Primera (5%) (solid blue line), and Centrum (5%) (solid yellow line). Additionally, there are two dashed lines representing adapter training for PELMS (dashed green line) and Primera (dashed blue line). The PELMS model shows a steady increase in performance as the number of training examples increases, reaching a score of around 19.0 at 64 training examples. The PELMS (5%) model also shows an increase but with a more gradual slope, ending at a score of approximately 17.0. Primera (5%) and Centrum (5%) have similar trends, with Primera (5%) slightly outperforming Centrum (5%) at 64 training examples. The adapter training lines for PELMS and Primera show a more pronounced increase in performance, with adapter training for PELMS reaching a score of around 18.0 and adapter training for Primera reaching approximately 17.5 at 64 training examples.
